title: Caretaker transition dispute escalates
detail: Disagreement over the caretaker setup and election administration triggered severe polarization and prolonged street agitation.

title: Violence and electoral legitimacy crisis
detail: Competing alliances challenged each other's legitimacy, and the election process became widely contested.

title: Emergency declared ("1/11")
detail: A state of emergency was declared, planned polls were halted, and a reconfigured caretaker administration assumed extended control.

title: Emergency-era governance and anti-corruption drive
detail: The non-elected administration launched broad administrative and anti-corruption actions while curbing normal partisan politics.

title: Political recalibration under restrictions
detail: Major parties underwent internal and strategic recalibration as negotiations over electoral return continued.

title: Return to election-based transfer
detail: National elections were held, ending prolonged emergency-era administration and restoring elected parliamentary government.
